owner_system: LinkedIn and the account owner — outside this repository.

surface_decides: platform rendering, truncation, link treatment, and final publish action
core_decides: editorial content, verification, content-type fit, and voice fit

constraints.format: feed post or article handoff; mobile-readable paragraphs, no forced creator-template structure
constraints.length_hint: compact enough for feed reading; preserve a complete thought rather than optimizing to a fixed character target
constraints.citation_style: inline source links or concise attribution when factual claims require them
constraints.register: professional-personal; reflective first person is allowed, but generic thought-leadership hooks and engagement bait are not defaults
constraints.hashtags: optional, not required by the Core
constraints.call_to_action: optional; omit unless the request or content purpose genuinely needs one

publication_boundary: Only the account owner or an explicitly authorised platform workflow may publish; this repository prepares text only.

replaceable.note: The surface profile is replaceable by another professional social network profile without changing content-type truth or the optional suengj-style overlay.
